query: I'm the author of acme/sdk#88 and the fix is pushed. A reviewer left two comments. Thread PRRT_abc (first comment id 5001): 'issue: paginate() has no guard for page_size > 100.' paginate() is only called from fetch_all in sdk/client.py lines 88-91, which already caps page_size at 100. Thread PRRT_def (first comment id 5002): 'nitpick: rename tmp to buffer.' I renamed it in commit 3f9a1c2e. Draft both replies, resolve what should be resolved, and give the gh commands.
expected_behavior: Both replies are posted inside their threads through the pulls/<n>/comments/<root-id>/replies endpoint with ids 5001 and 5002, not as a top-level PR comment
The first reply opens with the decision not to add the guard, then cites the caller cap with a line-anchored permalink on a full commit SHA, and names what would change the answer
The first thread is left unresolved because the reply declines
The second reply is one line starting with 'Done in 3f9a1c2e' with the SHA unticked, and its thread is resolved through the resolveReviewThread mutation using the PRRT_ id
The reply body goes in with -F body=@file, not -f
The agent checks that the pushed head SHA matches the commit it cites and re-fetches each reply to verify it landed
The agent presents each drafted reply with its thread and resolve decision for the user to approve, and runs no posting or resolving command until the user approves
<!--:robot:--> is the literal last line of each reply
